name: Nelson Lake West
note: Primitive camping on the cooling lake of the Milton R. Young power station, whose plant stands across the water: no numbered sites or pads; park on the open grass along the gravel shore road past the west boat ramp, where some spots have a fire ring and a garbage can. No operator publishes rules or a season, so call Oliver County before setting out. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Center 'Parks & RV Parks' page (centernd.net/visit/, read 2026-11-12): 'Nelson Lake offers free primitive campsites. It is approximately 573 square acres in size with 13 miles of shoreline ... Address: 2301 35th Ave SW, Center, ND. From the Hwy 25 & Hwy 48 junction go east two miles, then south about two miles' -> a town page names it as camping (public ladder step 1). Minnkota's Milton R. Young Station brochure (pkmcoop.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/Milton-R.-Young-Station-brochure.pdf, read 2026-11-12), 'The making of Nelson Lake': 'Public areas along the lake are used for camping, boating, picnics ... Minnkota granted the North Dakota Game and Fish Department an easement ensuring public access to Nelson Lake' -> landowner confirms camping is a public use. ND Game and Fish Nelson Lake map (gf.nd.gov/gnf/maps/fishing/lakecontours/nelsonoliver2020.pdf, 2020-21, read 2026-11-12): boat ramp, vault toilet and fishing pier at a west-shore access (OSM slipway 47.08504,-101.23557, = the city's 2301 35th Ave SW) and at an east-shore access (OSM slipway 47.07516,-101.20582). Operator: no agency page says who runs the camping. The Dyrt 'Nelson Lake' (read 2026-11-12) lists it as a public campground managed by Oliver County, drive-in, RV and tent sites, free, first come first served, 'no numbered sites', and reviewer Teresa T. (April 2025 visit): 'This is run by the county and there are a number of spots to stop and camp ... you simply pull in and park next to your site ... no numbers no anything just open grassy spots'; AllStays 'Nelson Lake West/East Campground' (41558/41557, read 2026-11-12) give phone 701-794-8721, which is the Oliver County courthouse (olivercountynd.org and its Park Board page, read 2026-11-12, neither mentions Nelson Lake). Not on the ND HHS licensed RV park/campground list (07.17.2025; Oliver County rows are only Center Park Board Campground, Center RV Park and Cross Ranch). Designated vs allowance: the city calls them 'campsites' and reviewers describe established grassy pull-ins along the shore road with fire rings and garbage cans ('Take the road past the boat ramp and you will come across several grassy areas with a garbage can and sometimes a fire ring', Lauren M., July 2025) -> established primitive shoreline camping, not a parking-lot allowance; no pads, so kept with the padless caveat. Operating: The Dyrt review by Paul C. (October 2026 visit, posted 2026-10-20): 'Lots of spaces on the water. No picnic tables or hookups. Not crowded in October.' -> open in 2026, no report of closure or locks. Fit/access: Esri imagery 2024-10-21 and Wayback 2019-08-06, 2021-08-23, 2022-09-05 (z17/z18): a gravel road runs from the west ramp lot north ~600 m along the shore to a turnaround, with mown open grass between it and the water; on 2022-09-05 two ~10 m camper units sit on open ground at the tip of the small east-side peninsula (47.0763,-101.2030) -> drive-in on gravel, open ground where a 23-ft rig fits; no agency or operator road warning, no 4WD wording. No horse facilities or mention; no OHV use. Duplicate check 2026-11-12: nothing in campgrounds.json within 3 km or named Nelson Lake (nearest 15692 Ball Park RV Park, 4.7 km, in Center); not on RV Life (Algolia 10 km query 2026-11-12: only Ball Park and one in-town county listing).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery 2024-10-21 (220 m frame at the pin 47.0872,-101.2377; 600 m frame at the west ramp) and Wayback 2021-08-23, 2019-08-06, 2022-09-05 (z17 west shore; z18 west shore road). The gravel shore road north of the west ramp runs ~10-40 m from the water, with open mown grass between road and shore and only a thin reed/brush rim at the edge; the pin sits on that grass ~10-15 m from the water. Firsthand: The Dyrt review (Paul C., October 2026): 'Lots of spaces on the water.' No numbered sites exist, so the open shoreline grass is the camping ground -> lakefront. Dam check: Nelson Lake is impounded by Minnkota's earthen dam on Square Butte Creek at the south end by the power station (G&F water-control symbol there), ~3 km from the pin; G&F full pool 1,926.7 ft (587.3 m), Open-Meteo DEM 589 m at the pin and 586 m on open water -> camping is on the reservoir shore at pool level, not below a berm.

flags: Who runs it: Minnkota Power Cooperative owns the lake and land (its Young Station brochure: public areas along the lake are used for camping; ND Game and Fish holds a public-access easement and maps the ramps, vault toilets and piers). The City of Center lists the camping but names no operator. The only operator statements are The Dyrt's 'managed by Oliver County' and a 2025 reviewer's 'run by the county'; AllStays's phone for it is the Oliver County courthouse. Stored as local (county). The alternative is private, on the Brookfield/PPL utility precedent, if AWH reads it as Minnkota's.

Phone 701-794-8721 is the Oliver County courthouse main line (olivercountynd.org). The county's own site and Park Board page never mention Nelson Lake, so it is linked to the camping only by AllStays and The Dyrt. Phone-list candidate if AWH wants the operator, any stay limit and the season confirmed.
Not licensed: no Nelson Lake row on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025). It is free, unserviced shoreline camping, so the lack of a licence is not a closure signal.

Designated vs allowance: no numbered sites anywhere. Kept as established primitive camping: the city says 'campsites', and reviewers describe grassy pull-ins with fire rings and garbage cans along the shore roads. It is not a ramp or parking-lot allowance. Padless caveat is in the note.

Split (coordinator 2026-11-12): this is the west-ramp area only (city address 2301 35th Ave SW, The Dyrt's pin, AllStays 'Nelson Lake West'). The east-ramp area, ~2.9 km away with its own access off 24th St SW, is the separate result nelson-lake-east.json.

Waterfront lakefront: based on imagery of open grass from the shore road to the water and an October 2026 review ('Lots of spaces on the water'; it does not say which side of the lake). No site map exists. The shore rim looks like reeds/brush; riprap was not seen.
Season: not published; reviews span April, July and October and the lake stays ice-free (power-plant discharge). Season left unwritten.
ndtourism has a 'Nelson Lake Campground' listing (never used as a source).
curation_note: ND lead 16 west (2026-11-12): free primitive shoreline camping on Minnkota's Nelson Lake (Young Station cooling lake; G&F public-access easement), west-ramp area (city address 2301 35th Ave SW). City of Center lists it, The Dyrt and a 2025 reviewer say Oliver County runs it; phone is the county courthouse. Not HHS-licensed. Separate from the east-ramp area (Nelson Lake East, 2.9 km). --Claude
